title: Publisher — clean HTML
description: Pure engine: render a node tree to a standalone, framework-runtime-free HTML document with one deduped per-module CSS bundle. Bring your own ModuleRegistry (each module is a pure render(props, children) -> { html, css? }); publishPage walks the tree, escapes every prop by its schema-declared control type (url -> safe-URL, richtext -> DOMPurify, svg -> SVG profile, else HTML-escape), dedups CSS by moduleId (~60-80% shrink), splices author classes/inline-styles onto each rendered root, and assembles <!DOCTYPE> + reset + framework + module CSS + a deterministic CSP plan. Layered sanitization spine: HTML escape + safe-URL, CSS-value guard (expression()/{}/</), </style RAWTEXT neutraliser, injectable DOMPurify (configureRichtextSanitizer — fail-closed without it). Stateless + env-free; no Convex, zero npm deps. Ships a PublishPreview iframe-srcdoc pane. Harvested + decoupled from the Instatic CMS publisher (host caching / loops / visual-components / Layer-C islands left behind).
